title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-243t: TH_3 uses CIPHERTEXT_2 instead of PLAINTEXT_2 per RFC 9528
description:
## Bug: TH_3 hash input uses wrong data per RFC 9528

### Location
`lichen/subsys/lichen/edhoc/edhoc.c`, lines 834 (initiator) and 1230 (responder)

### Current code
```c
// Initiator (after decrypting ciphertext_2 -> plaintext_2):
ret = compute_th(ctx->th_3, ctx->th_2, 32, ciphertext_2, ct2_len,
                 id_cred_r.value, id_cred_r.len);

// Responder (after computing ciphertext_2 from plaintext_2):
ret = compute_th(ctx->th_3, ctx->th_2, 32, ciphertext_2, pt2_len,
                 ctx->ed_pubkey, 32);
```

### RFC 9528 requirement
Section 5.3.2/5.4.2: "Compute the transcript hash TH_3 = H(TH_2, PLAINTEXT_2, CRED_R)"

### Problem
PLAINTEXT_2 is the **decrypted** content = (ID_CRED_R || Signature_or_MAC_2 || ? EAD_2).
CIPHERTEXT_2 is the XOR-encrypted form on the wire = PLAINTEXT_2 XOR KEYSTREAM_2.

The code passes `ciphertext_2` (encrypted form) instead of `plaintext_2` (decrypted form). For SIGN_SIGN method 0 (XOR-only encryption, no AEAD), these produce different bytes and therefore different hash values.

Note: `plaintext_2` is correctly computed at line 751 and is available for the hash.

### Impact
P0: Produces wrong TH_3 value. Cascades to PRK_4e3m, MAC_3, TH_4, PRK_out, PRK_exporter, and all application keys. Makes implementation non-interoperable with RFC 9528-conformant implementations.

### Fix
In initiator path, change `ciphertext_2` to `plaintext_2`. In responder path (line 1230), the XOR result is written into ciphertext_2 in-place, so reorder: compute TH_3 over plaintext_2 BEFORE the XOR at line 1226-1228, or make a copy.
